verdict.rationale: Docusaurus is an open-source static site generator that builds MDX into static HTML. It has no hosted service, user accounts or API surface, so issuing scoped API credentials for an agent is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any credential or authentication system that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
